newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Monday softer on the U.S. dollar and pound sterling but was quoted firmer against the mark and the rand after a fairly quiet interbank session, dealers said.
"Nothing much really happened today. The market was a bit short so everyone wanted to avoid buying unnecessarily by quoting high. We were all just protecting our positions," one dealer said.
"There was no sign of the Reserve Bank today (to bail out the Zimbabwe dollar) he added.
At Monday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 11.0575/0675 against the U.S. dollar from late Friday's 11.0400/0500 while against sterling it slipped to 17.9200/9400 from 17.8890/9185.
It, however, posted gains on the mark at 6.5300/5500 from 6.5495/5580 and was also a touch firmer against South Africa's rand at 2.5000/5200 compared to 2.5020/5060.
